en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large motor ship at sea, viewed from the port side. The vessel has multiple masts and superstructures along the deck. In the lower left corner, printed text identifies the shipping company and its location, while in the lower right corner the ship's name, "M. S. 'LALANDIA'", is printed. The overall design and typography suggest an early–to–mid 20th‑century promotional postcard for an ocean‑going cargo or passenger ship.
